text:
maya: Quick sync 4: we need a micro migration doc for v1->v2 deprecations focused on embedding model swaps and the SDK param rename (embed_model -> model_id). goal: one page, tiny snippets, and a checklist for PRs. deadline: EOD Friday.
ben: I can draft the TL;DR banner and the short "what changed" bullets.
evan: I9ll handle the Python snippet. want to show a defensive pattern: check dims, fall back to pinned model, and surface a clear error for CI. keep it minimal.
tara: I9ll do the TS snippet and a tiny smoke test harness. request: keep code runnable in node18 + add expected-dim assertion.
sam: Heads-up: product wants explicit language about reindexing. suggested banner line: "Embedding vector lengths may change after model swaps; reindexing required to preserve search results."
maya: good. ben  can you soften to "we recommend reindexing"? legal prefers softer wording.
ben: sure. draft banner: "Deprecation: /v1/models will be retired on 2026-04-15. If you swap embedding models, vector lengths may change; we recommend reindexing or pinning model IDs in production."
evan: snippet idea (py):
```py
# Defensive embed call: prefer pinned model if dims mismatch
meta = client.models.metadata('my-embed-v2')
if meta['embedding_dim'] != EXPECTED_DIM:
    # fallback to a pinned stable model
    vec = client.embeddings.create(model='my-embed-v1', input=[text])
else:
    vec = client.embeddings.create(model=meta['id'], input=[text])
assert len(vec[0]) == EXPECTED_DIM
```
tara: TS sketch:
```ts
// tiny smoke test harness
const meta = await client.models.get('my-embed-v2')
const dims = meta.embedding_dim
if (dims !== EXPECTED_DIM) {
  // use pinned model
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'my-embed-v1', input: ['hi'] })
} else {
  await client.embeddings.create({ model: meta.id, input: ['hi'] })
}
// assert shape in test runner
```
sam: add a short bullet about batching: "If you change dims, cached/batched vectors may be incompatible; clear caches and validate batch pipelines."
maya: localization: please wrap any banner copy in i18n keys and provide source strings in PR description. deadline for translations: 2026-03-31.
ben: PR checklist for docs reviewers:
- include banner copy and sidebar placement (deprecations)
- add both snippets (py + ts) and smoke tests
- link to reindex guide + samples repo
- run snippet smoke tests in CI (node18 + py3.10)
- mark strings with i18n keys
- add an issues label: docs-migration
sam: I9ll open PR branch: docs/migration/mini-embed-swap by tomorrow morning. can someone run node smoke test? tara offered.
tara: I got node. will run tests and push results as comments on the PR.
docs-bot: Reminder: please add the migration doc to the deprecations sidebar and file issue # with label docs-migration.
maya: one more user-facing line request from product: "We recommend pinning model IDs in production to avoid accidental swaps." add to TL;DR.
ben: added. also included mapping note for SDK param rename: `embed_model` -> `model_id` (one-line example).
evan: small note for implementers: runtime will NOT convert embeddings across dims; reindexing or pinned aliases required. adding that sentence to the FAQ section.
maya: timeline recap: draft by tomorrow EOD, review by Friday midday, merge by 2026-03-25 to allow translations.
sam: sounds good. opening PR now (WIP).
ben: I9ll post the draft banner and bullets here when ready.
maya: thanks team. keep the doc lean and link to samples for full patterns.
